- Option B — 2026-10-08 01:00-02:30 UTC (APAC-friendly; late APAC morning, US late evening)
- Option C — 2026-10-14 16:00-17:30 UTC (alternate EU/US overlap)

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm which slot works for your SRE lead (cc’d if helpful) and Security/Procurement contacts?
- Wavefront procurement: can you confirm PO timing and if you need an estimate or MAP (attached) for approval?
- Security team: we’ve attached a short SOC2 questionnaire (stub) — any additional evidence you’ll need ahead of the session?

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) listing roles and deliverables we propose. If these windows aren’t feasible, tell us your 2–3 preferred UTC windows and we’ll rotate availability on our side.

Regards,
